newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian Gulf Bank launching mutual fund.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian Gulf Bank launching mutual fund.

text.p: Egyptian Gulf Bank said on Wednesday it was launching a capital growth and income mutual fund concentrating on Egyptian equities.
The fund, the 14th launched on the Egyptian market in the past three years, will aim to raise 50 million pounds ($14.7 million) but this could be increased to 100 million, it said.
The bank will start taking subscriptions for a period of up to two months, starting in about two weeks. It can close after 15 days if it is already fully subscribed.
The minimum subscription will be 10 units worth 100 pounds each and the managers will be Hermes Fund Management, led by Alaeddin Saba, the bank said.
The fund will pay dividends twice a year, in January and July. Egyptian Gulf Bank is putting five million pounds into the fund as seed money, it added.
All the Egyptian mutual funds have performed well, thanks to the sharp rise in share prices over the past year.
Prices have fallen sharply in the past month but brokers say they expect them to rise again when new funds start buying.
